form.label: Forwarder Health
form.description: Is the data still arriving? A SIEM fails silently when a forwarder stops: dashboards keep rendering and rules keep showing as enabled. This view and the OPS-01 alert are what make that failure visible.

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=tcpin_connections | eval sourceIp = if(isnull(hostname), sourceHost, hostname) | stats latest(_time) AS last_seen, sum(kb) AS kb_received, values(version) AS uf_version, values(os) AS os BY sourceIp, guid | eval minutes_silent = round((now() - last_seen) / 60, 1), status = case(minutes_silent > 60, "Inactive", minutes_silent > 15, "Degraded", true(), "Active"), last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%F %T"), mb_received = round(kb_received / 1024, 2) | sort status, sourceIp | table sourceIp, status, last_seen, minutes_silent, mb_received, uf_version, os | rename sourceIp AS "sourceIp", status AS "status", last_seen AS "Last check-in", minutes_silent AS "Minutes silent", mb_received AS "MB received", uf_version AS "UF version", os AS "OS"

index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=tcpin_connections | eval serverName = if(isnull(hostname), sourceIp, hostname) | stats latest(version) AS SplunkVersion, latest(arch) AS Architecture, latest(os) AS OS, latest(_time) AS last_seen BY serverName | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%F %T"), version_current = if(SplunkVersion = "9.4.3", "current", "UPGRADE NEEDED") | sort serverName | table serverName, SplunkVersion, version_current, OS, Architecture, last_seen
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=tcpin_connections | eval sourceIp = if(isnull(hostname), sourceHost, hostname) | timechart span=30m sum(eval(kb/1024)) AS MB BY sourceIp

| tstats count WHERE index=linux OR index=linux_audit OR index=linux_logs OR index=windows OR index=windows_audit OR index=windows_logs OR index=sysmon OR index=db_input BY index, _time span=30m | timechart span=30m sum(count) BY index

| tstats count AS events, latest(_time) AS last_event WHERE index=linux OR index=linux_audit OR index=windows OR index=windows_audit BY host, index, sourcetype | eval last_event = strftime(last_event, "%F %T") | sort host, index, - events | rename host AS "Host", index AS "Index", sourcetype AS "Sourcetype", events AS "Events", last_event AS "Last event"

index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd component=FileIntegrityChecker | stats latest(_time) AS last_check, count AS messages, count(eval(log_level="ERROR" OR log_level="WARN")) AS failures | eval "Splunk version" = "9.4.3", "Check status" = "enabled", "Results valid?" = if(failures = 0, "true", "false"), "Last check" = strftime(last_check, "%F %T") | table "Splunk version", "Check status", "Results valid?", "Last check", failures

panel.title: Installed files failing the integrity check

html.p: Files shipped by the Splunk Enterprise package that have been modified or are missing since installation. An entry means the on-disk file no longer matches the signed manifest - expected for files this deployment intentionally edits (etc/system/local/*.conf), worth investigating anywhere else.

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd component=FileIntegrityChecker (log_level=WARN OR log_level=ERROR) | rex field=_raw "(?:File|Path)\s*[=:]\s*'?(?<file_path>[^'\s,]+)" | rex field=_raw "(?<integrity_issue>missing|modified|checksum mismatch|disabled)" | eval shared_object = if(match(file_path, "\.(so|dll)$"), "yes", "no"), intentional = if(match(file_path, "etc/system/local|etc/apps/siem_core"), "yes - deployed config", "no") | stats latest(_time) AS last_seen BY file_path, integrity_issue, shared_object, intentional | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort intentional, file_path | rename file_path AS "File path", integrity_issue AS "Issue", shared_object AS "Shared object", intentional AS "Expected?", last_seen AS "Last seen"

(index=linux_audit sourcetype=linux:hosthealth) OR (index=windows_audit sourcetype=windows:hosthealth) | stats latest(cpu_used_pct) AS cpu, latest(mem_used_pct) AS mem, latest(disk_used_pct) AS disk, latest(uptime_secs) AS uptime, latest(uf_version) AS uf_version, latest(os) AS os, latest(_time) AS last_report BY host | eval uptime_days = round(uptime / 86400, 1), last_report = strftime(last_report, "%F %T") | table host, os, cpu, mem, disk, uptime_days, uf_version, last_report | rename host AS "Host", os AS "OS", cpu AS "CPU %", mem AS "Memory %", disk AS "Disk %", uptime_days AS "Uptime (days)", uf_version AS "UF version", last_report AS "Last report"
